# paraguascrypto.com

> Premium .com domain for sale. Spanish "paraguas" means umbrella (not the country Paraguay). Brand position: Crypto Umbrella.

- Asking price: 27500 USD
- Contact: sales@desertrich.com
- Transfer: Escrow.com or a mutually accepted escrow service
- Included: the domain name and DNS control only
- Not included: a product, customers, token, or trademark warranty
- Pronunciation: pah-RAH-gwahs KRYP-toh
